479:t_1:3.en: ～ Inside the Imperial Capital $$ラース・バビロン$$ ～

479:t_1:4.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「...That's everything in the data $$ダバラーン$$ collected. What do you make of it, $$アウストラリス$$?」

479:t_1:5.en:
$$アウストラリス$$
「I can hardly believe it...」

479:t_1:7.en:
$$アウストラリス$$
「Why were people who reached this level left alone...」

479:t_1:8.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「Well, considering whose jurisdiction this universe falls under, it can't be helped. Especially when they even used something like a dimensional cage on top of it.」

479:t_1:9.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「What are you talking about?」

479:t_1:10.en:
$$アウストラリス$$
「It's still none of your concern.」

479:t_1:11.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「You're hard on newcomers, Your Majesty the Emperor. So basically, until I steal the $$いがみ合う双子$$, I'm treated as half-baked.」

479:t_1:12.en:
$$アウストラリス$$
「If you understand that, I have nothing more to say.」

479:t_1:14.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「No good, $$アムブリエル$$. It's my turn to sortie next.」

479:t_1:15.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「I'm stuck minding the house?」

479:t_1:16.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「Don't pout like that. Your factor is every bit as good as $n's.」

479:t_1:17.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「If you seize that $$ジェミニオン$$, you could enter the Third Stage right away, I'd wager.」

479:t_1:18.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「Then all the more reason. Otherwise, His Majesty the Emperor will never acknowledge me, no matter how long it takes.」

479:t_1:19.en:
$$アウストラリス$$
「...I forbid you to sortie.」

479:t_1:21.en:
$$アウストラリス$$
「$$エルーナルーナ$$ is receiving a special mission. Do not interfere with it.」

479:t_1:22.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「As expected of $$アウストラリス$$. You understand how I do things.」

479:t_1:23.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「So that's how it is, $$アムブリエル$$. Your boy hunting will have to wait for the next chance.」

479:t_1:25.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「Aww... she's gone and sulked.」

479:t_1:26.en:
$$アウストラリス$$
「If she lacks even that much spirit, she has no right to sit in this seat.」

479:t_1:27.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「In that case, all of $c's Reactors pass. $n included.」

479:t_1:28.en:
$$アウストラリス$$
「Yes... That man... is on the verge of reaching the Third Stage.」

479:t_1:29.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「Heh heh... Who'd have thought we'd find humans who can awaken the $$いがみ合う双子$$. And two of them, at that.」

479:t_1:30.en:
$$アウストラリス$$
「It must be because of the peculiarity of this planet called Earth.」

479:t_1:31.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「Maybe... I've brought down countless planets so far, but I've never seen one like this.」

479:t_1:32.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「Even I'm starting to lose track of how to crush the spirit of the people on this planet.」

479:t_1:33.en:
$$アウストラリス$$
「Is it because the $$オリジン・ロー$$ gathers here...? Or is it precisely because it is like this that the $$オリジン・ロー$$ gathers...」

479:t_1:34.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「Doesn't matter. As far as I'm concerned, I'll just achieve my goal quickly and move on to the next stage.」

479:t_1:36.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「I know. I'll carry out the mission.」

479:t_1:37.en:
$$アウストラリス$$
「...The power that the people of this planet hold is gradually beginning to take shape...」

479:t_1:38.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「Thanks to $c moving in various places, cracks are showing in our lines here. If this keeps up, the wind could change.」

479:t_1:39.en:
$$アウストラリス$$
「We must stop the evolution of this planet's people. To do that, striking at where it begins would probably be the most effective.」

479:t_1:40.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「The blood of a beast, huh... That kid... is very much my type.」

479:t_1:41.en:
$$アウストラリス$$
「I leave the operation to you.」

479:t_1:42.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「I don't need one. A beast's fight comes down to kill or be killed, nothing else.」

479:t_1:49.en:
$$葵$$
「That makes my overall simulation record seven wins to three losses.」

479:t_1:52.en:
$n
「I'm not going to pass up a chance like this. You almost never agree to be my opponent in the simulation.」

479:t_1:53.en:
$$葵$$
「OK. Today I'll keep at it with you all the way.」

479:t_1:54.en:
$$タケル$$
「Hang on, $$葵$$, $n. Going back-to-back like this is too much, no matter what.」

479:t_1:55.en:
$$シンジ$$
「Please rest a little. There are drinks, too.」

479:t_1:56.en:
$$葵$$
「Aren't you sweet, $$シンジ$$ and $$タケル$$ both.」

479:t_1:58.en:
$$葵$$
「Hehe... thanks. ...Or do you have some ulterior motive?」

479:t_1:60.en:
$$タケル$$
「That's enough teasing, $$葵$$. You're scaring $$シンジ$$.」

479:t_1:61.en:
$$葵$$
「Then will you be my opponent, $$タケル$$?」

479:t_1:66.en:
$$ラルク$$
「Do you know why $$葵$$ has gone strange?」

479:t_1:68.en:
$n
「It's... um... I used to be a $$ビーストハンター$$... so I know... a fair amount... about how animals live...」

479:t_1:69.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Is this the time for a self-introduction!?」

479:t_1:72.en:
$n
「...Isn't it what they call... an animal's... mating season...?」

479:t_1:75.en:
$$ラルク$$
「You mean she's in heat, so to speak?」

479:t_1:77.en:
$$葵$$
「Well, aren't you something for saying that, $n.」

479:t_1:79.en:
$$葵$$
「No need to be so scared. I'm not going to gobble you up while Miss $$スズネ$$ is away.」

479:t_1:83.en:
$$葵$$
「You don't need to apologize. ...You're probably right, after all.」

479:t_1:85.en:
$$葵$$
「So keep me company. Until this boiling blood settles down, you're my simulation opponent.」
